svg.title: A. Developer workbench — original proposed layout blueprint
svg.desc: Original precision layout proposal for a Postman redesign. This is not a current Postman screenshot or a finished Figma design. The app region is 1440 by 900. All labels remain SVG text. UI rendering font is Open Sans; code font is DejaVu Sans Mono.
svg.text: Request, response and team context in one place
